question: Which of the following is the standard means by which elections are conducted in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electronic Voting Machine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, the use of **electronic voting machines (EVMs) i**s the norm for **conducting elections**.
 
• The** government-owned Electronics Corporation of India** and** Bharat Electronics** designed and tested the technology in the **1990s.**
 
• They were gradually incorporated into** Indian elections **between **1998 and 2001.**
 
• India used** paper ballots and human counting** before the introduction of electronic voting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blockchain:**

 
 
• Blockchain is a** decentralized, immutable database** that makes it easier to **track assets and record transactions** in a corporate network.
 
• An asset may be** tangible (such as a home, car, money, or land)** or **intangible **(intellectual property, patents, copyrights, branding).
 
 
 
• **Email:**
 
 
• Email is often known as **electronic mail.**
 
• It is a form of** digital communication **that sends messages via** electronic devices.**
 
 
 
• **Ballot paper:**
 
 
• A ballot paper is a** piece of paper** that lists all of the candidates running for office, together with their** party names and logos.**
 
• The ballot was** previously utilized. **
